title: etale limit affine degree zero kernel
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed preorder, D : Iᵒᵖ → Scheme a diagram of affine qcqs schemes with affine transitions, and c a limit cone. Let F_i be abelian sheaves on the small etale sites of D_i, with inverse-image transition maps phi satisfying the identity and composition laws. Let G_i be their pullbacks along c.pi_i, with specified isomorphisms eG commuting with transitions, and let L be a colimit cocone for G. If x in H^0(F_i) has zero image in H^0(L.pt) under pullback followed by the colimit leg (eG_i)^(-1);L_i, then there is a stage j and an arrow f : i → j for which the pullback of x followed by phi_f is zero in H^0(F_j). Conventions: schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]; abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]; inverse images [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]; cohomology and pullback maps [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]; diagrams, cones and colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

proof.text: The limit of affine schemes is affine by Mathlib Scheme.isAffine_of_isLimit. Specialize the existing filtered-cohomology colimit theorem on this limit scheme to degree zero. Transport its cocone first through the natural derived-degree-zero/global-section isomorphism and then through H.equiv₀. The filtered-colimit equality criterion in AddCommGrpCat supplies j and f : i → j at which the representative in H^0(G_i) becomes zero.

Apply H^0((eG_j).hom) to this zero. Expand hG and cancel (eG_i).inv with (eG_i).hom and (eG_j).inv with (eG_j).hom. The composition and coefficient-naturality formulas for cohomological pullback identify the resulting class with p_j^*(y), where y = H^0(phi_f)(D(f.op)^*(x)). Thus p_j^*(y)=0.

Apply fixed-coefficient affine degree-zero vanishing to y at j. It supplies k and g : j → k with D(g.op)^*(y)=0. Expand hcomposition for f and g. Pullback composition identifies its first factor with the iterated pullback of x, and coefficient naturality identifies the next factor with pullback of y. The final coefficient map sends zero to zero. Therefore f followed by g is the required arrow.

proof_origin.place: Factor the formal iterated-colimit argument into fixed-scheme filtered H^0 and fixed-coefficient inverse-limit vanishing. Lean proves the coefficient/composition glue explicitly.

theorem etale_limit_affine_degree_zero_kernel
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ (i j : Iᵒᵖ) (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, IsAffine (D.obj i)]
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G) (hL : IsColimit L)
    (i : I) (x : Sheaf.H (F i) 0)
    (hx : Sheaf.H.map ((eG i).inv ≫ L.ι.app i) 0
      (cohomologyMap (c.π.app (op i)) (F i) 0 x) = 0) :
    ∃ (j : I) (f : i ⟶ j),
      Sheaf.H.map (φ f) 0 (cohomologyMap (D.map f.op) (F i) 0 x) = 0
